type F = ((...x: number[]) => void) | ((...x: string[]) => void);
function f(g: F) { g(1); }
type G = ((...x: number[]) => number) | ((...x: number[]) => string);
function h(g: G) { const n: number = g(1, 2); return n; }
type H = ((a: number, ...r: string[]) => void) | ((a: number) => void);
function k(g: H) { g(1); g(1, "s"); }
type I = ((a: number) => void) | ((a: number, b?: string) => void);
function m(g: I) { g(1); g(1, "x"); }
type J = ((a: string | number) => string) | ((a: string) => string);
function p(g: J) { return g("s").length; }
type K = ((...x: (string | number)[]) => void) | ((a: string, b: string) => void);
function q(g: K) { g("a", "b"); g("a"); }
